newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Olympia shares to resume trading Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Olympia shares to resume trading Tuesday.

text.p: Trading in the shares of Malaysia's Olympia Industries Bhd will resume on Tuesday, the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said on Monday.
The stock was suspended from January 4 at the company's request pending an announcement. It was last traded at 2.21 ringgit.
Olympia said on Monday it plans to acquire an 88-acre freehold land in Kuala Lumpur for 750 million ringgit.
It is also proposing to issue 80 million new shares at 2.14 ringgit for approved Bumiputra (ethnic Malay) investors.
Olympia said the proposed acquisition of the land was aimed at strengthening its property development business and improve future profitability from recurrent rental income.
